To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SWI/SNF is recruited to promoters that are active in the hypertrophic heart.

the SWI/SN F chromatin remodeling complex is recruited to promoters that are active in the fetal heart and that regulate the fetal gene program, and that SWI/SNF is activated in the hypertrophic heart resulting from salt‐induced hypertension.

the protein levels and chromatin occupancy of several SWI‐SNF subunits required for cardiac development, Brg‐1, Baf‐60c, and Baf‐180, are elevated in hearts that hypertrophy in response to salt induced hypertension.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms by which salt‐induced hypertension causes cardiac hypertrophy, a pathological condition that can lead to heart failure.
understanding how chromatin remodeling enzymes regulate cardiac gene expression in the setting of hypertension.
the molecular mechanisms of cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure, and how they are influenced by hypertension.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SWI/SNF proteins are upregulated in the hearts of Dahl salt‐sensitives fed a high salt (8% NaCl) diet, and that these proteins are enriched on the promoters of two fetal cardiac genes.
this paper provides evidence that the SWI/SN F chromatin remodeling enzymes play a role in the pathogenesis of salt‐induced hypertension‐mediated cardiac hypertrophy.
the SWI/SFN chromatin remodeling enzymes play an important role in cardiac hypertrophy that results from salt induced hypertension in the Dahl S rat.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

SWI/SNF proteins are upregulated in hypertrophic hearts and that they are associated with fetal cardiac gene promoters, which may contribute to the fetal cardiac gene reprogramming that occurs in hypertrophic hearts.
salt induced hypertension activates SWI/SNF complexes to promote the fetal cardiac gene expression program and cardiac hypertrophy.
SWI/SNF complexes are recruited to promoters that control the fetal cardiac gene programs and that this recruitment occurs in hypertrophied hearts resulting from hypertension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SWI/SNF complexes are activated in hearts from rats with salt induced hypertension.
salt‐induced hypertension leads to the activation and recruitment of the SWI/ SNF chromatin remodeling complex to promoters of genes that regulate the fetal gene program in cardiac hypertrophy.
salt induced hypertension leads the heart to become “fetalized” and that this process is regulated by chromatin remodeling enzymes that are recruited to promoters of the fetal cardiac genes.
